title: Combination Herbal Therapy (CHT) Versus Placebo in Patients With Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
brief_summary: This is an 8-week double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized, parallel-group study with an additional two week baseline observation period to evaluate the safety of combination herbal therapy (CHT) versus placebo and short and long-term efficacy in terms of improved IBS, overall quality of life (QOL) and symptomatology.
